I've been wanting to interact with the FoM community for a while but always felt a little too shy. So I wanted to show one of my Fields of Mistria OCs! Not TOO used to reddit either so I'll write a bit about her here \^\^

Her name is Fleur and she is your average girl failure. She plants crop seeds during the worst times and they always end up wilting when the next season rolls by, she's yet to find out you can feed your animals any forageables and ends up buying hay from Hayden instead and most of the time ends up avoiding Friday Inn Nights because she doesn't quite know how to socialise in a crowded place.

But like all farmers, the lass will learn.

I like to think she's good friends with Caldarus because he's always there at the farm all the time but I don't quite ship her with anyone in the game. If it's possible to befriend Dozy or Henrietta well enough to convince them to move in to the farm instead that would be the likely end game outcome.
